reading: before: one claim_agentic_chat_turn per read (6 calls = 1 admission + 5 fences); no fence claim received an AbortSignal, so a timed-out check keeps running; the timeout surfaced as a generic Error and classified as failure_class 'unknown'.

after: one shared fence claim for the four-wide burst plus one fresh claim for the queued fifth read (3 calls); the shared claim's signal was aborted with AgenticChatReadToolFenceTimeoutError at the deadline; the fifth read's claim was never aborted; the failure classified as 'transient_infra' with a specific code.

The injected hang stalls only the first check. In the live incident every check stalled because the database itself was slow for ~46 s; the reproduction proves the worker-side mechanics (fan-out, no cancellation, classification), not the database cause.
